depth_justification: The Swiss regulatory framing is genuinely app-specific and correct (nFADP/FADP, BAG calendar, MedDO/Swissmedic, GDPR Art. 8 parental consent, DE/FR/IT, cantonal age thresholds, optional-name minimization), but the identical four-dimension block (P2.D3/P3.D2/P4.D4/P5.D1) is repeated verbatim five times with zero new analysis, and citations are vague placeholders ([nlpd_base · p.0]) rather than precise.
actionability_justification: Advice is mostly directional (implement encryption, apply data minimization to the optional name, add an age gate, provide an Art. 19 information notice, define retention/auto-deletion); the final severity-grouped report ties these together but offers few concrete recipes or exact configurations.
